items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 25:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that the light of Ein Sof does not clothe in the Partzuf except through clothing in the light of Hochma, and the light of Hochma does not clothe in the Partzuf except through clothing within the light of Hassadim. And therefore there is no complete coupling except through the two kinds of influx (as above in Item 168). And therefore first one needs the influx of existence and standing, which is drawn from the GAR of Bina, which is the light of Hassadim in abundance. And then the light of Hochma, which is the influx of the second kind, called blessing and freedom and the dainties of kings, can clothe within the Hassadim in the Partzuf, which is drawn from the GAR of Bina, and then the coupling is complete, for the light of Ein Sof clothes there within the light of Hochma. Behold, there is no true completion except through the two kinds of influx mentioned above. (Item 52).
